correctness.rationale: Generic affine-edge cuts classify sections by the middle of three projected positive vertex heights. Crofton conditioning integrates offsets to give E median/E max. The exact pair-maximum sphere integral is L/2, and the standard polyhedral edge-angle mean-width identity gives E max=T/pi with explicit fourfold edge families. Analytic differentiation T_prime=S_prime*phi yields a unique strict axial maximum. Exact endpoints and finite-cut checker substantiate normalization; simulations are not infinite proofs.
